description: Search Salesforce accounts by name, industry, type, location, or contact information. Multiple filters are combined with OR, so accounts matching any filter can be returned; without filters, returns recent accounts.

billing_city.description: Search by billing city. Supports partial matches.
billing_city.human_parameter_description: The city listed on the account’s billing address. Enter a city name to filter matching accounts.
billing_city.title: Billing City

billing_country.description: Search by billing country. Supports partial matches.
billing_country.human_parameter_description: The country from the account's billing address. Enter the country name to filter results.
billing_country.title: Billing Country

billing_state.description: Search by billing state/province. Supports partial matches.
billing_state.human_parameter_description: The state or province from the account’s billing address. Use an abbreviation or full name.
billing_state.title: Billing State

fields.description: Comma-separated list of valid Salesforce Account field API names to retrieve. Only use actual field names like Id, Name, Industry, etc. Do not include type annotations or placeholders like <string> or <DATE_TIME>. If any field in this list is restricted by field-level security, the entire request will fail — use a minimal set of standard fields (e.g., Id,Name,Website) when access is uncertain.
fields.human_parameter_description: Which account details you want back. Provide a comma-separated list of fields to include in the results.
fields.title: Fields

industry.human_parameter_description: The industry the account belongs to. Use a keyword to narrow results to accounts in that industry.
industry.title: Industry

limit.description: Maximum number of accounts to return. Results are hard-capped at approximately 2000 rows; use more selective filters if the full dataset exceeds this.
limit.human_parameter_description: How many accounts to return at most. Lower this to get a smaller, faster result set.
limit.title: Limit

name.description: Search by account name. Supports partial matches.
name.human_parameter_description: The account name you want to look up. Enter a full or partial name to find matching accounts.
name.title: Name

phone.description: Search by phone number. Supports partial matches. Requires field-level security access to the Phone field.
phone.human_parameter_description: The account's phone number or part of it. Use this to find accounts by their phone number.
phone.title: Phone

type.description: Search by account type. Note: The Type field may not exist in all Salesforce orgs. If the query fails with 'No such column Type', either omit this parameter or use a custom Type__c field if available in your org.
type.human_parameter_description: The kind of relationship this account has with you (e.g., Customer, Prospect, Partner). Note: This field may not be available in all Salesforce orgs.
type.title: Type

website.description: Search by website. Supports partial matches.
website.human_parameter_description: The account’s website or part of it (like the domain). Use this to find accounts by their web address.
website.title: Website

name: search_accounts

CreatedDate.title: Created Date

Industry.description: Industry that the account operates in.
Industry.title: Industry

LastModifiedDate.description: DateTime when the account record was last modified (ISO 8601 format).
LastModifiedDate.title: Last Modified Date

OwnerId.description: Salesforce User ID of the account owner.
OwnerId.title: Owner Id

Phone.description: Primary phone number for the account.
Phone.title: Phone

ShippingAddress.description: Compound field containing the shipping address components. Read-only field introduced in API v30.0.
ShippingAddress.title: Shipping Address

Type.description: Type of account, such as Customer, Competitor, or Partner.
Type.title: Type

AccountRecord.title: AccountRecord

geocodeAccuracy.description: Accuracy level of the geocoding for the address.
geocodeAccuracy.title: Geocode Accuracy

RecordAttributes.description: Metadata object containing information about the record type and resource URI for RESTful navigation.

type.description: The Salesforce object type of the record (e.g., 'Account').
type.title: Type

url.description: The REST API resource URI for accessing this specific record (e.g., '/services/data/v53.0/sobjects/Account/001D000000IRFmaIAH').
url.title: Url

RecordAttributes.title: RecordAttributes

SearchAccountsResponse.description: Response from Salesforce SOQL query for Account records.

done.description: Indicates whether all records have been returned. When true, no additional records can be retrieved. When false, additional records remain to be retrieved via pagination.
done.title: Done

nextRecordsUrl.description: URL path containing the query locator for retrieving the next batch of records. Present only when done is false and additional records remain to be retrieved.
nextRecordsUrl.title: Next Records Url

records.description: Array of Account records returned by the query. Maximum of 2000 records per response.
records.title: Records

totalSize.description: The total number of records that match the SOQL query criteria.
totalSize.title: Total Size

SearchAccountsResponse.title: SearchAccountsResponse
